summary:
## What is Pinokio?

**Pinokio** is a free, all-in-one desktop application that allows you to install, run, and manage various AI models and applications with a **one-click install** process. It eliminates the need for manual coding, dependency management, and complex setup procedures, making powerful AI tools accessible to everyone.

## Getting Started

1.  **Download:** Visit the Pinokio website and download the installer for your operating system (Windows, Mac, Linux).
2.  **Install:** Run the installer like any other program.
3.  **Discover:** Navigate to the **Discover** tab within the app to browse a wide catalog of AI models.
4.  **Download Script:** Select an AI model you want to use (e.g., Face Fusion) and click 'Download'. This saves a small script file.
5.  **Install Model:** From the model's main page in Pinokio, click the **Install** button. This will download all necessary files and dependencies.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Installing a full AI model can be a large download and may take around **20 minutes** per package, depending on your internet speed and computer hardware.

6.  **Launch:** Once installed, click the **launch** or **start** button. Pinokio will spin up a **local server** and provide a URL or an integrated 'Open Session' window to access the AI tool's interface.

> [!TIP]
> To shut down a running model and free up system resources, navigate to its server process window within Pinokio and click the **Stop** button.

## Featured AI Models Demonstrated

*   **Face Fusion**: A tool for swapping faces between a source image and a target image or video. The demo shows its effectiveness and how the built-in *Face Enhancer* can improve results.

*   **Illusion Diffusion**: Generates creative optical illusion images by embedding a pattern (like circles or squares) into a scene described by a text prompt. You can adjust the **illusion strength** to make the pattern more or less subtle.

*   **L-Edits++**: An image editing tool that uses text prompts to modify parts of an image (e.g., changing a car's color to "green car"). Results may require some fine-tuning of parameters.

*   **Open Voice**: A local voice cloning model. You provide a reference audio file, and it will read new text in that voice.
    > [!NOTE]
    > While free and local, its quality is not as high as paid, cloud-based services like ElevenLabs.

*   **VideoCrafter**: A rudimentary text-to-video model. The results can be "cursed" and experimental.
    > [!IMPORTANT]
    > This model is resource-intensive and caused the host's computer to crash during the demonstration.

*   **Focus**: A popular and user-friendly image generation tool, similar to Stable Diffusion, that can be run locally through Pinokio.
